propositions: Pass-1 submits all chunk and agent futures at once into a 6-wide pool, so the first ~6 concurrent calls each pay a full cache write for the byte-identical plan-bearing system prefix.
Cold-cache prefix duplication yields roughly 7.9N effective plan-tokens versus an ideal 2.15N (~3.7x overhead).

Port the proven container-bin warm gate to the main pool: when shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and chunks plus agent criteria >= 2, run the first single-turn chunk serially to write the cache before fanning out the remainder.
Small plans below the token gate and single-call reviews should bypass the warm-up and behave unchanged.
A non-systemic warm-call failure must gracefully degrade to direct fan-out and still complete the review.
With the gate met, the shared prefix should incur exactly one cache write and N-1 cache reads, verifiable via per-call usage metrics.
